source_prior: counted source posterior mean and covariance from the finite-source preflight
evidence: Gaussian log marginal likelihood under each fixed prior, using noise SD 0.15 and the acquired target parent/output pairs
nomination: scratch minus source log evidence after first four target observations must be positive
confirmation: scratch minus source log evidence increment on subsequent observations must exceed log(4); zero subsequent observations cannot switch
prediction: switch to scratch posterior fitted on all acquired target observations if both conditions pass; otherwise retain warm-source posterior fitted on all observations
allocation: identical frozen uniform target prefixes and target budgets as the parent screen; no adaptive targeting
scoring: independent existing 1024-point target test design; changed labels and truth only at evaluator
development_gate: At 200 target examples, for each source size and family-change k in {1,3,10}, changed-node MSE of switch policy <=1.05 times scratch MSE and untouched-node MSE <=1.05 times warm-source MSE. For coefficient changes, changed and untouched MSE must each be <=1.05 times the better of scratch and warm-source. Report nomination, switch, false-switch rates and exact counts. Passing does not authorize fresh confirmation alone.
custody: check source hashes, parent baseline metric parity, identical acquired prefixes, 144 cell receipts, deterministic replay, source revision, and zero closed-model calls
